rationale.faithfulness: The excess half of the decomposition works and transfers: excess concentrates at the day edges (0.80-1.00, CIs exclude the time share) and trimming removes 81-100% in 3/3 periods, as predicted. The kickoff and housekeeping predictions failed or are unresolved (the synthetic showed the kickoff is not identifiable); NE43 failed its rule, NE41 mixed (pulse is mostly the consolidation gap). Two estimator fixes after the first real-data pass. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I1.
rationale.usefulness: A computable scheduler gauge and a concrete preprocessing rule: trim to the all-present window before any behavioral irreversibility statistic, because the staggered day stop carries 72-100% of the excess. It does not yield a work or coordination gauge (housekeeping below the floor) and does not see kickoffs.
